review:
An 8x8 cluster forest with bears, wolves and deer. Clusters of five or more win and tumble, and coloured marked spots award different modifiers when they're part of a win – transforming wilds, colossal symbols, or clearing and refilling the board.

Winning symbols count towards Gold Fever: 114 unlock the first level, applying 2x to all wins, and further levels push it higher. A spiritual successor to Gems Bonanza. 96.05% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
